def f(sudoku):
    options = dict((num, range(1, 10)) for num in range(1, 10))
    columnsFilled = dict((num, 0) for num in range(1, 10))
    rowsFilled = dict((num, 0) for num in range(1, 10))

    for i in range(9):
        for j in range(9):
            if sudoku[i][j]!= 0:
                num = sudoku[i][j]
                columnsFilled[j+1] |= 1 <<num
                rowsFilled[i+1] |= 1 <<num

    emptyCells = [(rowIdx + 1, colIdx + 1) for colIdx in range(9) for rowIdx in range(9) if not sudoku[rowIdx][colIdx]]

    def solvePuzzle():
        if not emptyCells: return True

        i, j = emptyCells[0]
        possibleVals = options[j] & ~(rowsFilled[i] | columnsFilled[j])
        
        while possibleVals:
            value = min(possibleVals)
            sudoku[i-1][j-1] = value
            options[j] &= ~value
            rowsFilled[i] |= value
            columnsFilled[j] |= value
            
            possibleVals &= value - 1
            
            if not columnsFilled[j]&(value - 1) or not rowsFilled[i]&(value - 1) or not options[j]:
                sudoku[i-1][j-1] = 0
                options[j] |= value
                rowsFilled[i] &= ~value
                columnsFilled[j] &= ~value

            else: 
                if solvePuzzle():
                    return True
                
                sudoku[i-1][j-1] = 0
                options[j] |= value
                rowsFilled[i] &= ~value
                columnsFilled[j] &= ~value
        return False

    solvePuzzle()

    return sudoku


def f(inputs: List[Tuple[int, List[int]]]):
    
    sudoku = [input_data.split() for input_data in inputs if input_data]
